s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of altered mental status and metabolic acidosis in a patient with multiple comorbidities and recent surgery
salient_findings: Severe metabolic acidosis with high anion gap
key_facts: 75-year-old woman with prosthetic hip infection
Recent revision surgery
Chronic kidney disease with baseline creatinine 130-150 μmol/L
Hypertension, type 2 diabetes, heart failure, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and folate deficiency
Home medications included aspirin, bisoprolol, atorvastatin, furosemide, gliclazide, pantoprazole, folic acid, inhaled bronchodilators, and as-needed oxycodone
Intravenous vancomycin and acetaminophen started on admission
Glasgow Coma Scale score of 12
Temperature 36.2°C, blood pressure 145/66 mmHg, pulse 80/min, respiratory rate 24/min, and oxygen saturation 99% on room air
Sodium 142 mmol/L, potassium 3.5 mmol/L, chloride 118 mmol/L, bicarbonate 5 mmol/L
Blood urea nitrogen 8 mmol/L, creatinine 150 μmol/L
Hemoglobin 10.0 g/dL, neutrophils 16.5×10^9/L, platelets 485×10^9/L
Albumin 17 g/L
Arterial blood gas: pH 7.18, pCO2 1.7 kPa, pO2 16.7 kPa, bicarbonate 8.3 mmol/L, base excess –22.7 mmol/L
Corrected anion gap 25 mmol/L
